A follow-up to the one-shot ''[[Star Wars Adventures: Shadow of Vader's Castle]]'', the series, written by [[Cavan Scott]], consists of five issues and follows up on the heroes of the earlier ''Vader's Castle'' miniseries. [[Francesco Francavilla]] illustrates the framing stories, which will focus on [[Vaneé]], while [[Derek Charm]], [[Megan Levens]], [[Chris Fenoglio]], and [[Robert Hack]] will also provide artwork.
